name: Collapsible
summary: One section that opens and closes, with the open state owned by the app.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 2026-08-27 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: Enter, Space.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What you click to open and close. It becomes the button, and the chevron is added in front of it.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel's content. It stays in the DOM when closed, so in-page search still finds it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Starts open without controlling it. Do not switch this after mount on an uncontrolled Collapsible — the engine warns about it in as many words.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires with the new state, from the trigger or from the keyboard.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The trigger stays focusable and inert, so keyboard users still find out the section exists.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the outermost element, after the Aurea skin — your class wins on a tie.
